sources.title: On Issues in Swiss Cheese Compactifications

evidence.text: Analyze the axion-sector gradient and covariant Hessian with its field-space metric, including connection terms. Diagonalize kinetic and mass terms at weak coupling to identify a light axionic combination, and estimate e-foldings along the saddle-to-minimum trajectory.

sources.title: On Issues in Swiss Cheese Compactifications

evidence.text: For the inverse problem, introduce auxiliary complex P^I, recover charges through p^I=Re(P^I) and q_I=Re(N_IJ P^J), and solve attractor conditions at fixed complex W=w. Near the conifold, eliminating one P reduces the problem to two quadratic equations.

sources.title: On Issues in Swiss Cheese Compactifications

evidence.text: Insert perturbative and nonperturbative α′ corrections and loop corrections into the Kähler potential, and flux plus instanton terms into W, then use the N=1 F-term potential. Euclidean D3 instantons wrap divisors satisfying the unit arithmetic-genus condition; their prefactors involve Jacobi theta functions.

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quantum-corrected flux compactifications support four-dimensional de Sitter geometry while retaining a controlled supergravity description? The supplied analysis studies this through an M-theory background related to type IIB by dimensional reduction and T-duality.

sources.title: Realisation of de Sitter space as an excited state in string theory

evidence.text: Can the type IIB construction of four-dimensional de Sitter space as a Glauber–Sudarshan excited state be extended to heterotic SO(32) and E8 × E8 theories, with controlled EFT evolution and compatible axion constraints?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Represent the specified warped de Sitter target as an excitation of a static soliton while retaining time-dependent supporting fields.

sources.title: Four-Dimensional Null Energy Condition as a Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: The construction asks which external FLRW histories can be supported by time-dependent internal geometry and fluxes while retaining a constant four-dimensional Newton coupling and an organized M-theory effective action.

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Determine whether static or evolving internal compactification data can support quantum-corrected de Sitter equations together with a controlled lower-dimensional expansion. Solving the equations and establishing a Wilsonian effective action remain distinct issues in the source.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: How can quantized fluxes, quantum corrections and warped supersymmetry breaking produce stabilized four-dimensional candidate de Sitter vacua, and how can errors in the approximate effective theory be assessed?

sources.title: Resurgence of a de Sitter Glauber-Sudarshan State: Nodal Diagrams and Borel Resummation

evidence.text: Can a time-dependent geometry arise as an excited-state expectation value while heavy modes are defined on a static supersymmetric reference vacuum?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a coherent state over an AdS type IIB soliton produce de Sitter geometry? The source leaves this open because localized excitations alter the compactification as well as spacetime, while static internal profiles resist the stated on-shell construction.

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB String Theory: Classical Solutions and Quantum Corrections

evidence.text: Can ten-dimensional type IIB compactifications with fluxes and localized sources yield four-dimensional de Sitter geometry, and what conditions must quantum curvature corrections satisfy to evade classical obstructions?
